text:
Situation: Ursodiol 300 mg capsules are not on FDA's drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Corvale General holds 303 capsules, providing 31.6 days of supply at the current usage rate.

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list previously recorded Strides Pharma Inc. discontinuing manufacture of ursodiol capsules with an initial posting date of 2026-04-06. The product is not on the current shortage list.

Our position: Current inventory covers approximately one month. Multiple alternate manufacturers are available and not on the shortage list. No immediate clinical restriction is required.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place orders with Actavis Pharma, Inc. as the top-ranked option; requires buyer approval.
2. Buyer to qualify Amneal Pharmaceuticals NY LLC as a secondary source; requires buyer approval.
3. Buyer to qualify Aurobindo Pharma Limited as a tertiary source; requires buyer approval.
4. Buyer to evaluate AvKARE and AvPAK for additional supply redundancy; requires buyer approval.
5. Pharmacy director to confirm purchasing agreements and delivery timelines; requires pharmacy director approval.

Not recommended: No allocation, rationing, or therapeutic substitution at this time.
